protocol.length_measure: Unicode regex tokens: words and individual non-whitespace punctuation; diagnostic lengths, not DistilBERT WordPiece counts
protocol.review_selection: Up to ten false positives and ten false negatives per model and evaluation, restricted to errors shared by all three seeds; sort by mean wrong-class confidence, then prompt ID
protocol.purpose: Descriptive error analysis only; no checkpoint, threshold, or configuration selection using evaluation results

limits: Three-seed stability is descriptive, not a statistical confidence interval.
Length buckets use regex tokens; DistilBERT truncates WordPiece tokens.
Cross-source distributions and labels differ; no scores were used for model selection.
High-confidence error samples require manual review; labels are not independently adjudicated.
